name: Rookie of the Year
epitaph: The WWO's own Simply the Best Awards named Tyrone "Purple" Hayes its 1999 Rookie of the Year — the same year his own bio card credits him with debuting.

name: Heel of the Year
epitaph: Tyrone "Purple" Hayes swept both the WWO's own 1999 Rookie of the Year and Heel of the Year Simply the Best Awards.

name: Best Stable
epitaph: Voted to Carnage-a-Trois, Todd Johnstone's own stable of Tyrone "Purple" Hayes and Latex Lex, in 1999.

name: Manager of the Year

bestowals.vote_detail: tied — the fed's own held record does not name the co-winner

epitaph: A tied 1999 award; the fed's own held record names only one half of the tie, Todd "The Rod" Johnstone.

name: e-PWI 500
epitaph: The wing's own in-house emulation of Pro Wrestling Illustrated's PWI 500, voted by a small circle of the fed's own handlers and published with its own methodology confession attached -- a ranked list of the community's own wrestlers rather than only this wing's own roster.

bestowals.vote_detail: Ranked #1 of 35 on the wing's own in-house "e-PWI 500" ballot, voted by a small circle of the fed's own handlers. The published list ranks wrestlers across the whole community by federation credit, not only this wing's own roster; its own compiler states plainly that the vote was slanted by which handlers had Usenet access.
